utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at my place on Maple Street next Thursday at 7. I’ll text everyone the book title once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Opal — thank you. Once you confirm the title, I’ll send a tidy note to everyone with the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll confirm the title and send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful—thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye out for the details and the book choice.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll text you the time, address, and the book pick as soon as I have it. And yes, I’ll keep you posted if I hear the choice before then!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate the heads-up and I’ll watch for your text. If I hear anything second-hand, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re talking about the next meeting — I’ve got the date and snack list if you want me to fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please — I’d love the date and snack list, and I’m especially curious what book the club picked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — the meeting’s on Thursday evening, and I’ve got chips and fruit on the snack list. The book we picked is the one about the lighthouse, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please — I’d love the date and snack list, and I’ll try not to forget it this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll check the date and snack list for next Thursday evening and confirm whether it’s at the library.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, next Thursday evening sounds great — thanks for checking on the library too. I’ll try to remember my notes this time!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday after school at the library still works for me — I’ll send the details out to everyone. We just need to make sure it fits around the kids’ school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I might’ve missed that. Thursday after school at the library sounds fine to me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Noah — I’ll send the details to everyone and keep it after school at the library on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a spare folding chair and a couple pitchers if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s really kind of you, Gus — thank you. I’m mostly listening this week, but I’d love to hear what book the club picked.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Haven’t heard the final pick yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do. Happy to bring the chair and pitchers either way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just send me the title when you know it, and I’ll pick it up on my next errand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — what title do you want me to send?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any title is fine—I just need the book name, and I can grab it on my next errand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still haven’t heard the new title, but I’d like to know soon so I can put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re just picking the next book together, and I can fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Let me know the title when you all decide, and I’ll add it to my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, just keep me posted on what they pick tonight—I’m dying to know if it’s a cozy mystery or something more dramatic.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll let you know as soon as they pick one. Hope it’s a good one!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the time and exact place before I can confirm. Can you check and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — I’ll check the time and place and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll wait for the details before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nope, you’re good — we’re reading a mystery novel this month.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh great, a mystery sounds perfect — count me in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the latest details so you’re all caught up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just text me the title and time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll text you the title and time as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re meeting Thursday at 7, same place as usual. I’ll bring the notes and we can go over the chapters one by one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll be there Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, see you then. I’ll keep it simple and stick to the usual plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — Thursday after school at the library still works for me. I’ll send the details out to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just text me the title when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll text you the title as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re reading a mystery novel this month.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nice, a mystery should be fun. If the club needs chairs or pitchers, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — chairs would be great. I’ll let the group know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help pick the next book and send a quick reminder to the group. Do you want me to choose a title, or do you have a few options in mind?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I have a few options in mind, and I’ll send you a tidy shortlist so we can choose something gentle and easy to discuss.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — send me the shortlist when you’re ready, and I’ll help pick the best one for the group.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the Thursday evening book club time and whether it’s at the library, then I’ll confirm for you.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Hana. I’m mostly just listening this week, so either way is fine with me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check Thursday’s book club time and the library location, then I’ll let you know once I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send you the details right away, and I’ll let you know what they pick tonight too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re talking about the next meeting — I’ve got the date and snack list if you want me to fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please—send me the date and snack list, and I’ll pass it along to Tess too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time works for you, and should we meet at the library on Oak Street?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: The library works for me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How about 7 PM? If that works, we can pick the next book tonight too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, great — just send me the title when you know it, and I’ll pick it up on my next errand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm the time and place first? I don’t want to show up at the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it’s Thursday at 7, same place as usual. If that’s right, I’ll grab the title on my next run out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring the tea, and we can pick the next book together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’m in — tea and a group pick sounds like the best book club setup. Just tell me when you’ve narrowed it down!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll narrow it down and let you know soon — then we can pick the next book together over tea.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes please — I’d love the date and snack list, and I’ll try not to forget it this time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the date or snack list yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and pass it along. Maybe they’ll settle on something cozy… or something that sparks a lively debate.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess — I’ll appreciate that. Hopefully it’s something cozy, but I’m ready for a lively debate too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send you the latest book club details and make sure you’re in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara — I’d love that. What book did the club pick?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check and send the pick right over — I want to make sure you’re in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — we’ll meet at the library after school on Thursday. I’m just waiting on the book title.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Lovely, thanks, Opal — I’ll keep an ear out for the book title and pass it along if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Nell — if you hear the title, please send it my way too.

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
